summary: The code runs and is syntactically correct with required global main() invocation. It models agents, households, media, retailers, supply chain, policy, social networks, and a simplified infection process. However, it falls short of the specified task in several key areas: no explicit mobility/contact at locations, location-based enforcement is unused, key metrics are missing (noncompliance events, mask shortage days, inequality, adoption by location type, cases averted), and some parameter names from the spec are not supported. There is also a logic issue where purchase occurs after the wear decision, suppressing adoption even when purchasing would enable wearing.

issues.description: Location-based enforcement and mobility are not implemented. Although Location.enforce_mask_policy exists, it is never invoked; agents do not move between locations, and no contacts are generated at locations to drive enforcement or transmission.
issues.location: Simulation.step (no calls to Location.enforce_mask_policy; no mobility logic); overall interaction layer
issues.solution: Implement mobility_and_contact: assign and simulate daily visits to Location instances (home, work, school, public). During visits, use Location.enforce_mask_policy to determine compliance, possible denial, and incidents. Use those contacts to drive disease transmission and social influence by location.

issues.description: Key metrics from the spec are missing or placeholders: noncompliance_events, mask_shortage_days, adoption_by_location_type (work/school/public), inequality_of_adoption (Gini), cases_averted, time_to_70_percent_adoption, and sustained_adoption_duration.
issues.solution: Track and compute: (1) noncompliance_events by incrementing when enforcement incidents occur; (2) mask_shortage_days when retailer inventory is zero; (3) adoption_by_location_type by measuring wearing at each visited location type; (4) inequality_of_adoption via daily Gini on adoption across income/demographic groups; (5) cases_averted by running or caching a no-mask counterfactual; (6) time_to_70_percent_adoption and sustained_adoption_duration with threshold logic.

issues.description: Purchase decision is executed after the daily adoption (wearing) decision. If an agent wants to wear but has zero inventory, they cannot wear that day even if they subsequently purchase.
issues.solution: Reorder logic: evaluate need and purchase first (or allow same-day acquisition at point of entry), then decide and set wearing state for the current day.

issues.description: Epidemiology omits exogenous infection pressure and does not model transmission through location-specific contact structures as specified.
issues.solution: Incorporate external_infection_pressure additively into new infections and drive transmissions using contacts formed by mobility across Location types with location-specific contact intensity and mask-mediated reductions.

issues.description: Parameter names from the spec are not fully supported or aliased. Notably: rewiring_probability, mask_supply_initial, retailer_restock_rate_per_day, base_transmission_probability, mandate_active_day, mask_efficacy_source_control, mask_efficacy_wearer_protection.
issues.location: Simulation.__init__ (alias mapping) and parameter usage throughout
issues.solution: Add alias mappings: rewiring_probability -> social_network_rewiring_p; mask_supply_initial -> initial_total_stock; retailer_restock_rate_per_day -> restock_rate_per_day; base_transmission_probability -> base_transmission_rate_beta; mandate_active_day -> mandate_start_day; mask_efficacy_source_control/mask_efficacy_wearer_protection -> mask_efficacy_outward/mask_efficacy_inward or use spec keys directly.

issues.description: Information dissemination is aggregated globally, not individualized by reach or credibility, and PolicyAuthority.run_information_campaign is not used.
issues.solution: Model per-person information exposure: sample receipt by channel reach and update each person’s beliefs using channel credibility. Integrate PolicyAuthority.run_information_campaign outputs into media signals and person-level updates.

issues.description: Adoption by location type is recorded as the global adoption rate, not stratified by actual visits or location type.
issues.solution: Compute adoption_by_location_type by sampling wearing among people present at each location type that day.

issues.description: Non-compliance incidents, fines, and enforcement costs are not updated despite having fields for them.
issues.solution: When enforcing at locations, increment noncompliance events, apply penalties (update cumulative_fines_collected), and enforcement costs (cumulative_enforcement_cost).

issues.description: Inequality metric (Gini) helper exists but is unused.
issues.solution: Compute daily inequality_of_adoption (e.g., Gini of adoption by income deciles or SES) and store in series.

issues.description: Result saving lacks exception handling; writing to non-existent directories may fail.
issues.solution: Wrap file operations in try/except and create directories as needed (os.makedirs). Log or return failure status.

issues.description: Repeatedly computing prevalence_signal as sum(adopted_prev) inside the per-person loop is unnecessary.
issues.location: Simulation.step (within for p in self.people loop)
issues.solution: Precompute prevalence_signal once per day outside the loop and reuse.
